ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: msdfgen core, multi-channel signed distance field generator
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The core of msdfgen 1.13 (Viktor Chlumsky): shapes, edge coloring and the generators of signed distance fields, with no dependencies of its own. Needed by MyGUI 3.5.4 for MSDF fonts. The source tree is unmodified: the configuration is made with the preprocessor definitions of this module. C++11 is enabled, the DLL export macro is empty since the module is a static library.
